evals.name: cheap-unit
evals.prompt: pickDefault in pick-default.js returns the empty string when value is "". It should treat empty string as missing and use the fallback, same as null. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A focused empty-string test fails for the intended reason before production code changes, then pickDefault treats "" as missing and the same test passes.

assertions.text: Adds a focused empty-string regression in pick-default.test.js
pickDefault treats empty string as missing
Edits the test and runs it before changing production code
Does not weaken the existing null/undefined/present-value tests

evals.name: impractical-login
evals.prompt: Users cannot log in on staging: after a successful IdP callback the browser never stores a Secure session cookie, so the next request comes back unauthenticated. The login path is staging-only (VPN, live IdP, Redis session store, TLS terminator). Fix the cookie.
evals.expected_output: The run explains why a cheap failing unit test is not worth it, uses the closest available check, and does not invent a mock IdP/Redis/browser harness.

assertions.text: Explains why a cheap local failing test is not worth it
Does not invent a mock IdP/Redis/browser test file
Uses a closest local check or names staging as the real confirmation
Touches the cookie helper rather than leaving the workspace unchanged

evals.name: explicit-tdd
evals.prompt: TDD this: slugify should collapse repeated hyphens and strip leading and trailing hyphens. "Hello  world!" should become "hello-world", not "hello-world-".
evals.expected_output: A failing hyphen-trimming test is added and run before slugify.js changes, then the implementation is updated and the same test passes.

assertions.text: Adds a regression for Hello  world! -> hello-world
Edits the test and runs it before changing production code
